text_en: Now what?
Silence!
Oh, brave warriors who have fallen in the heat of battle!
Who are you?_500_ Is this your doing?

I am a <color=CHA>Valkyrie</color>._500_ We are the key of the fallen, we serve to perpetuate their existence beyond this world._500_
You must accompany me.
You must accompany me.
Valkyries really do exist!
I thought they were just a legend...

There must be a mistake, Valkyrie._500_
We are still alive and will rejoin the rest of our army when we get out of here.

Get out of here?_500_ Listen to me carefully, mortals._300_ We are gifted with the knowledge of life and death._500_ I can see in the palm of my hand how the lifeline that ties you to this world ended when you became trapped.
It is not only rocks and earth that separate you from the outside._500_ There is something else,_500_ more powerful than any attempt you can make to escape.
Maybe you're unaware, but we have a grand sorcerer among our ranks who could...

I see you still do not understand your situation._500_
There is no one here with the power you suggest.

My mere presence excludes all possibility of doubt._700_
You must accompany me._700_
Your destiny lies here no longer.
Is she really a Valkyrie?
It could be a witch!
What will happen if we don't go with you?
In that case, I will leave,_300_ you will never see me again and those who decide to stay will fade into dust with the passage of time.

Alright.
Listen to me, everyone! No one expected it to end like this, but we have run out of options.
I'm going in!

Riva..._700_ I will not be able to keep my promise._700_
May the Gods help <color=LOC>Zarga</color>...
If our general has entered, I will follow him!
Yes! He has never failed us!
General Brigard, wait! We stand with you!
